price.description: Picks eco/standard/premium by simple rules for text prompts. Optional min_tier sets the minimum tier. X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Tier report the choice. Only POST /v1/chat/completions. If the chosen model's seller refuses before payment, the router picks the next model of the tier or the next tier up, never below min_tier; after payment it retries once with another model of the same tier only if it costs no more than the price quoted, otherwise the request fails with 503 and no charge; X-SingIt-Model and X-SingIt-Tier show what actually answered.
